marketing_description: The Milwaukee 2545-20 M18 Cordless Jig Saw features a compact design with an ergonomic grip, variable speed control, and orbital cutting action. Powered by a 5 Ah M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 battery, this tool offers up to 30 minutes of run time and a 2 to 3 hour charge time. The tool-free blade change and LED light provide added convenience and visibility.
